selector.temporaryDebugDiagnostic: LayerStates DWG output profile skipped: LAYER_CONTROL extension dictionary is outside its versioned LayerStates root profile
selector.diagnosis: The typed extension 0xD5 has a validated common-link-tail marker, but the existing three-root profile requires that marker to be false. Other checked root profile fields were printed and matched. The same false-marker restriction appears in fe603f3e, before the one-root change. Debug-only test modifications were restored and the adapter rebuilt.
selector.comparison: The older p4-ac1024-layerstates-xrecord-source-admission-2026-11-01.json reports this exact source hash and selector passed; the present failure supersedes its claim for the current head. The moment and cause of the marker change are not established.

independentTrace.peerJsonAcquisition: Same dwgread -v4 -O JSON command recorded in independentTrace; pass explicitly using --peer-json. When omitted, runner expects aerial-libredwg.json beside the trace.

reuseAssessment.candidate: dx_raster_wire::detail::eed in dwg2dxf/dx_raster_dwg_wire.h yields bounded APPID role/handle and exact EED item spans, including R2007+ UTF-16; inspectEed/captureEed in dx_iface.cpp show typed token matching and source-name dependency binding.
criticalGaps: Integrate the exact-witness UTF-16 byte comparison and unique, unchanged APPID 0x12 source-name binding into the production profile with an appropriately source-bound read context; the research probe alone cannot qualify output.

Integrate and independently review source-bound dictionary/XRECORD/SCALE observer and end-to-end refusal/retry controls in the production profile; standalone research spans alone do not authorize output.

Prove entire NOD source wire as needed, immutable typed/class-row provenance, same-import-session/projection evidence and output remapping; the exact 32 observed SCALE frames and independently observed links alone do not establish full production graph closure.
Unknown body, string or handle tails must remain refused, with malformed/truncated EED, wrong APPID/roles/targets, destination preservation and same-adapter retry controls.
reuseAssessment.currentResult: Standalone probes match six dictionary frames, primary and nested XRECORDs, and all 32 SCALE source frames to live typed capture and pinned independent LibreDWG JSON/trace. The selected NOD edge is corroborated, but full NOD wire, production output, immutable baseline and class-row rechecks, end-to-end export rollback/retry and native consumer semantics remain open. No guard or support claim is changed.

limitations: Trace and raw-frame observer describe this one exact physical witness; they do not establish broad producer or version support.
The previous multi-root projected-output result is historical and does not pass on the current head.
This is a test-only projected profile, not whole-source or native consumer semantics.
No external drawing fixture was committed.

Production integration requires a genuine same-import-session LAYER_CONTROL proof and preservation of the matching APPID source snapshot in any test-only projection; existing projected tests may lack those and must not synthesize provenance.

boundedEedProbe.result: PASS: source and peer trace SHA-256 guard, independently decoded APPID 0x12 name ACAD and EED fields, matching live typed EED values, APPID role/handle/name and source-name snapshot, token spans and UTF-16 text bytes. Wrong handle role, wrong APPID, changed text, unknown code, and truncated EED are rejected; corrected retry succeeds. Hash guard rejects incorrect source and trace.
boundedEedProbe.limits: Source-specific EED byte and APPID-name evidence. This is not end-to-end export refusal/retry, native consumer testing, production integration, or a profile admission. The live typed dictionary was matched; its captured typed baseline was checked for presence but not independently compared.

boundedDictionaryProbe.build: The runner builds libdxfrw_test_adapter, then compiles a scratch executable with -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror and links it to the built adapter and libdxfrw.
boundedDictionaryProbe.result: PASS: captured raw bodies, detached UTF-16 names, string presence/size footer and ordered handle streams agree with the typed unique dictionaries and the independently decoded LibreDWG 0.14 trace. Six source frames are tested; this is a standalone research observer and does not relax any output guard.
boundedDictionaryProbe.negativeControls: 128 dictionary mutations covering body, string byte, footer, owner/reactor/item role and target, inserted extra body bit, truncated handle stream and extra handle byte are rejected; original-byte retries succeed for all but the appended-byte case. The extra-body-bit mutation changes the declared body endpoint and is rejected by the fixed-profile endpoint check; it does not independently prove that an otherwise accepted length cannot hide a body gap. Separately, existing EED role/target/text/code/truncation controls pass. These are research-observer controls, not file-export destination or adapter retry tests.

formatReference.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

boundedDictionaryProbe.limits: Fixed source hash and one exact source graph only. Six dictionary raw frames, including SCALELIST, are observed. The independent peer and live typed NOD both contain its selected edge, but this dictionary probe does not decode the complete NOD wire. All 32 SCALE frames are examined by a separate bounded observer; this does not establish output remapping or native behavior. The live typed dictionary is checked against raw and peer; its captured typed baseline is checked for presence but not separately compared.

boundedNestedXrecordProbe.negativeControls: 13 controls: raw self, EED flag, xdictionary flag, data byte count, group code, referenced target, cloning, no-string bit, owner role, reactor role and target, truncated handle stream, and appended handle byte; original-byte retries succeed except appended-byte test. This is not a fileExport sentinel or same-adapter retry.
boundedNestedXrecordProbe.limits: The code-330 payload points to 0x127; a separate observer verifies all 32 member source frames. Neither observer establishes output reference remapping, complete NOD wire, whole-file output or native behavior.

boundedPrimaryXrecordProbe.independentReference: Pinned LibreDWG 0.14 trace and JSON (including the empty group-301 string) plus Open Design Specification v5.4.1 §20.4.104.
boundedPrimaryXrecordProbe.result: PASS for the exact AC1024 primary XRECORD 0x249: all 11 typed values, 77-byte payload, cloning and common reference/tail fields match captured source bytes and the independent peer. Group 370 == -3 is a separately scoped producer-compatibility value, not a general XRECORD-domain claim.
boundedPrimaryXrecordProbe.negativeControls: 25 mutations exercise self, EED, xdictionary flag, byte count, each data group/value, cloning, no-string bit, owner/reactor/xdictionary role and target, truncated handle stream and appended handle byte. The observer rejects each; corrected raw-byte retries pass except appended-byte case. These are not fileExport or destination-sentinel tests.
boundedPrimaryXrecordProbe.limits: Pinned one-record observer. The live typed record is compared to the raw and peer evidence; its captured typed baseline is checked for presence but not separately compared. Does not establish output remapping, production graph closure, native LayerStates semantics, or general group-370 support.

boundedScaleListProbe.independentReference: Pinned LibreDWG 0.14 trace and JSON; Open Design Specification v5.4.1 §§20.1 and 20.4.44.
boundedScaleListProbe.result: PASS for the physical SCALELIST DICTIONARY 0x126: all 32 keys and ordered hard-owner-role wire targets match live typed and independent peer views; complete dictionary body, split string/footer and handle spans close. Peer JSON and live typed NOD independently contain the unique ACAD_SCALELIST -> 0x126 edge; all 32 typed SCALE target handles are unique and have owner 0x126.
boundedScaleListProbe.negativeControls: Per-item role and target corruption is rejected for all 32 entries, alongside dictionary common-field, string, footer, owner/reactor, inserted-body-bit, truncated-handle-stream and appended-byte controls. Inserted body bit changes the declared profile endpoint and fails the exact-endpoint check.
boundedScaleListProbe.limits: The NOD edge is compared between the live typed view and independent peer; the full NOD raw body/handle stream is not decoded by this proof. All 32 SCALE frames are examined separately, but their immutable same-import class-row binding, output remapping and native behavior remain unproven. No full-graph or broad support claim.

boundedAllScalesProbe.independentReference: All 32 expected names, finite numeric values, flags, sizes and exact owner/reactor encodings come from the hash-bound LibreDWG 0.14 JSON; the source drawing and accompanying peer trace are separately hash-bound. ODA v5.4.1 §§2.12, 2.13, 20.1 and 20.4.92 define the layout.

The runner builds an ephemeral peer manifest from hash-validated JSON; no drawing or peer fixture is added.

boundedAllScalesProbe.limits: Only this hash-bound witness and its 32 printable-ASCII names and finite numeric values are checked; the manifest uses std::quoted and is not a general JSON or arbitrary Unicode decoder. Source capture metadata is matched but immutable same-import class-row binding and all typed baselines are not independently proven. The complete NOD wire, actual output remapping, strict export failure/retry and native consumer semantics remain open. This does not promote a broad SCALE/DWG support claim.
